intent: To inform viewers about the rate of college diploma attainment among adults in Israel.

units.meaning: The college-diploma attainment rate among adults over 25 is about 47%.

basis.note: Table's printed share value is 47 percent.

accepted_routes: About 47% of adults over 25 have a college diploma.
The college-diploma attainment rate for people aged 25+ is roughly 47%.
Roughly 47 out of every 100 over-25s hold a college diploma.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The central donut share or label must show 47% for college-diploma attainment, with the over-25 population qualifier present in narration/on-screen text.
units.temporal_anchor: The main clause stating 'About 47% of those over 25 have a college diploma.'
units.reviewer_question: Should the 47% college-diploma share among over-25s be treated as the required central claim?

units.meaning: The complementary share without a college diploma is 53%.

basis.note: Complement derived from the table's 47% share.

accepted_routes: About 53% of adults over 25 do not have a college diploma.
The remaining share without a college diploma is roughly 53%.
If 47% have a diploma, about 53% do not.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If shown, the chart or on-screen text must make clear the complementary segment is 53% and is derived from 100% minus 47%.
units.temporal_anchor: Optional follow-on to the main 47% clause; should not replace the main 47% statement.
units.reviewer_question: Should the 53% complement be explicitly visualized or is it optional?

units.meaning: The 47% rate is below half, so it is not a majority.

basis.note: 47% is compared to the half threshold.

accepted_routes: At about 47%, this is below half.
Less than half of adults over 25 have a college diploma.
The rate is not a majority; it is 47%.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If this claim is made, the chart or narration must support reading 47% as less than 50%; a half/majority reference must not imply 47% is above half.
units.temporal_anchor: The main 'about 47%' clause, potentially with a contrasting phrase about half.
units.reviewer_question: Should the below-half/not-a-majority framing be required or left optional?

units.meaning: The same rate can be expressed as the proportion 0.47.
accepted_routes: The share is 0.47 of the over-25 population.
As a proportion, the rate is 0.47.
units.visual_evidence_rule: If shown, the decimal 0.47 must be presented as the same quantity as 47%, not as an additional or different rate.
units.temporal_anchor: Optional on-screen numeric variant accompanying the main 47% clause.
units.reviewer_question: Should the decimal/proportion form 0.47 be accepted as an optional representation?

units.meaning: The percentage applies to adults over 25 in Israel, not to all adults, all ages, or another country.

basis.note: Table supplies the 47% share; the over-25 and Israel scope comes from the narration/intent and is needed for the denominator.

accepted_routes: Among adults over 25 in Israel, about 47% have a college diploma.
For Israelis aged 25 and older, the college-diploma rate is 47%.
The 47% share is for the over-25 adult population in Israel.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Narration or on-screen text must identify the over-25 population and Israel context; the chart must not imply the 47% is for all ages or another country.
units.temporal_anchor: The clause 'those over 25' in the main narration sentence, plus any Israel context title.
units.reviewer_question: Should the over-25 denominator and Israel scope be treated as required context rather than optional footnote?

optional_valid: The chart is a single-share donut, so the video need not show a trend or ranking.
The value is approximately 47%, allowing rounded phrasing such as 'about 47%'.
If visually useful, the 47% can be described as close to but below half, without saying it is exactly half.
unsupported_to_avoid: Do not claim 47% of all Israelis or all adults have a college diploma; the narration specifies over 25.
Do not invent trend, causal, or demographic breakdowns not present in the table.
Do not treat 53% as a table value; it is only a derived complement.
Do not claim 47% is exactly half or a majority.
Do not use counts of people unless a population total is provided.
notes: The table has only one printed share: 47%, with relative_value 0.4700. The main required content is the 47% rate plus the over-25/Israel scope; complements and threshold framings are valid but optional.
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
